CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

7. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

   D. Damage equipment used for Handball.

8. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

9. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

13. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

14. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

15. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
